regra: RC-60: 1 aprendizado externo por turno. Não copiar. Converter em pergunta curta, script de follow-up, resposta de objeção, frase proibida/substituição premium ou métrica. Conteúdo externo é hipótese operacional testável por 3 dias, nunca regra clínica/financeira/jurídica nem promessa de resultado.
buscar: posts de alto engajamento sobre persuasão, objeções, atendimento, negócios locais ou experiência do cliente
entrega: 1 frase curta + 1 ângulo de objeção + 1 cuidado contra agressividade

LIVERY OPERATION. I HAVEN'T PAID A HUMAN RIDER IN FOUR MONTHS AND NOBODY ORDERING HAS NOTICED.

Delivery was always the job anyone could get. No experience, no interview, just a bag and a bike. That was the whole point of it the floor everybody could stand on when nothing else worked out.

Now the bag rides itself. It clocks in before sunrise, runs every order without a wrong turn, drops the food in the locker, and goes back out. It doesn't cancel in the rain. It doesn't quit for a better rate two blocks over. It doesn't take a cut.

I used to manage people. Now I manage batteries. The orders come in the same, the customer pays the same, the food shows up faster the only thing that changed is where the money stops at the end of the night. It stops with me now.

Everyone was watching the trades, the offices, the "creative" jobs. The floor went first. The one job that was supposed to always be there for anyone is the one that quietly disappeared.

In a few years this is every city. Right now most people still think the person on the bike is a person.",
